original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Produce and decode real Clifford observations from two literal binary operand tapes, use them to write the carried integer product, and prove a full cost benefit on a growing family.
scope_change_reason: The donor assigned the multiplication data path. Change the connector work from supplier accounting to a certified ordinary-input decoder branch.
bottleneck_link: The fixed complete callers traverse growing numbers of full fields. Materialising ordinary uncarried defect coefficients alone can require superlinear payload. See COMPARISONS.md.
stop_rule: Establish a complete family, exact product, full tape accounting and comparison with the strongest relevant complete schedules.
evidence: PROOF.md, COMPARISONS.md, EVIDENCE.json, VERIFICATION.md and the executable replay.
author: Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, formal proof, self-review and writing.

open_questions.question: Can equivalent high-sector charts share a signed partial contraction?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This could reduce the block-pair factor on growing mixtures.
open_questions.first_step: Bind a shared canonical chart and a local traversal to two separate required output blocks.
open_questions.blocked_by: Absolute phase and bit delivery must agree for both consumers.

open_questions.question: Which denser address sets admit a bounded carry chart?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This would broaden the certified input class.
open_questions.first_step: Test whether a single address carry preserves a bounded family of quadratic boundary states.
open_questions.blocked_by: Integer address carries can introduce nonlinear, state-dependent constraints.
